description: This file defines an interface named EntitlementConsumptionStrategy within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It specifies method signatures for handling leave entitlement consumption logic, such as creating, canceling, changing leave periods, and retrieving relevant leave data. The interface is part of the leave entitlement strategy subsystem, facilitating different implementations for how leave entitlements are consumed.

methods.name: handleLeaveCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation of a leave entry for an employee, returning current and changed leave entitlement data or null.

methods.name: handleLeaveCancel
methods.description: Handles the cancellation of a leave and returns the updated leave entitlement data.

methods.name: handleEntitlementStatusChange
methods.description: Handles changes in entitlement status (implementation-specific, no parameters).

methods.name: handleLeavePeriodChange
methods.description: Handles adjustments to leave periods when start dates change, with parameters for previous and new start month/day.

methods.name: getLeaveWithoutEntitlementDateLimitsForLeaveBalance
methods.description: Retrieves date limits within which leave without entitlements counts towards leave balance.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the leave period for a given date, employee, and leave type.
